description: This file defines the class DeleteAclEntryStrategy, which implements the strategy to handle DeleteAclEntry commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages the removal of access control entries from a Thing, validating permissions, and generating events and responses accordingly.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles DeleteAclEntry commands by removing the specified access control entry from a Thing.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to delete an ACL entry, validating and removing the permissions, and generating appropriate results or errors.

methods.name: extractAcl
methods.description: Extracts the AccessControlList from the given Thing if it contains the permissions for the authorization subject specified in the command.

methods.name: getDeleteAclEntryResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating the deletion of the ACL entry, including validation and event generation.

methods.name: getAclValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator instance to validate the ACL after removal of permissions.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the previous state of the Thing before modification.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the next state of the Thing after modification, if applicable.
